title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_dunenfluch_by_sven_koch_66l2o (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_dunenfluch_by_sven_koch_66l2o' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted computer. Removal of the package alone may not fully eliminate the malicious presence due to potential persistent control by an attacker.
